book.title: Table for One
book.subtitle: A personal menu, cooked and revised at home

dishes.name: Mushroom Velouté
dishes.description: Slow-caramelised onion · button mushroom · thyme · cream

steps.title: Caramelise the onion
steps.text: Melt the butter over low heat, add the onion and stir every 3-5 minutes. Deglaze with a spoonful of water whenever the fond darkens.

steps.title: Garlic & mushrooms
steps.text: Add the garlic, then the mushrooms, and cook until their liquid has evaporated and the edges colour.

steps.title: Wine & roux
steps.text: Deglaze with white wine, reduce, then stir in the flour for one minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Pour in the stock with the thyme and parsley. Simmer gently until lightly thickened.

steps.title: Blend & finish
steps.text: Blend until completely smooth, stir in the cream, season, and top with seared mushroom slices.

notes: Keep the heat low while caramelising. The onion should never turn black.
Thyme was too strong last time; this version is already reduced.
Blend longer. There were still onion flecks last time.

dishes.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
dishes.description: Golden garlic · chilli · olive oil · aged cheese

steps.title: Boil the pasta
steps.text: Cook the spaghetti 1.5 minutes short of the packet time.

steps.title: Cold-start the garlic
steps.text: Put the oil, garlic and chilli in a cold pan, then warm over the lowest heat until pale gold.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Lift the pasta straight into the pan and add the dried herbs and pepper.

steps.title: Emulsify
steps.text: Raise the heat, add pasta water and stir hard for 45-60 seconds until the sauce turns cloudy and clings.

steps.title: Season & plate
steps.text: Taste a strand, adjust with a pinch of salt, plate, and grate cheese over the top.

notes: Too oily last time. Cut the oil from 2.5 tbsp to 1-1.5 tbsp.
Do not stir on the heat for 3 minutes. 45-60 seconds, then off.
Season only after the sauce has emulsified, and by the pinch, never by the spoon.

dishes.name: Rigatoni alla Rosa
dishes.description: Blistered cherry tomato · cream · white wine · Parmigiano

steps.title: Prep & boil
steps.text: Halve the tomatoes, mince the garlic, grate the cheese. Cook the rigatoni 2 minutes short of the packet time.

steps.title: Sweat the garlic
steps.text: Warm the oil and butter over medium-low heat and cook the garlic gently until fragrant.

steps.title: Break down the tomatoes
steps.text: Add the tomatoes with a pinch of salt and pepper. Cook until jammy.

steps.title: Paste & deglaze
steps.text: Fry the tomato paste for 1-2 minutes, add the wine, scrape the base, and reduce.

steps.title: Cream & finish
steps.text: Stir in the cream, add the pasta and a splash of pasta water, then fold in the Parmigiano off the heat.

notes: Try adding half to one bay leaf next time.

dishes.name: Bucatini ai Frutti di Mare
dishes.description: Prawn · clam · scallop · shellfish stock · lemon

items.name: Prawns, peeled
items.note: keep shells and tails for the stock

items.name: Lemon
items.note: peel for aroma, wedge to serve

steps.title: Purge the clams
steps.text: Soak the clams in cold salted water in a dark place, then scrub the shells.

steps.title: Shell stock
steps.text: Toast the prawn shells in olive oil until deep red, add stock and bay leaf, simmer 10 minutes, and strain.

steps.title: Sear the seafood
steps.text: Pat the prawns and scallops dry, sear briefly until half-cooked, and set aside.

steps.title: Build the sauce
steps.text: In the same pan, sweat the onion, garlic and lemon peel in butter, then cook down the tomatoes.

steps.title: Reduce
steps.text: Add the wine, clams and shell stock. Reduce until the sauce is lightly thickened before the pasta goes in.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Toss in the bucatini with a splash of pasta water, return the seafood, and finish with cold butter, lemon juice and parsley.

notes: Use only the shells from this batch of prawns for the stock.
Let the sauce thicken slightly before adding the pasta.
Keep some pasta water to help the sauce thicken.
Stir a little lemon juice into the sauce just before plating.

dishes.name: Spinach Gnocchi, Prawn Bisque Cream
dishes.description: White prawn · spinach purée · zucchini · 24-month Parmigiano

steps.title: Prep the prawns
steps.text: Peel and devein, keep the heads and shells, and marinate the prawns in the fridge for 10-15 minutes.

steps.title: Shell reduction
steps.text: Fry the heads and shells until red, deglaze with wine, add water, reduce, and strain.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear the prawns and zucchini in olive oil, then set aside.

steps.title: Cream sauce
steps.text: Sweat the onion and garlic, deglaze with wine, add the cream, shell reduction and thyme, and simmer.

steps.title: Gnocchi & finish
steps.text: Boil the gnocchi until they float, fold into the sauce with the spinach purée, Parmigiano and butter. Top with prawns, lemon zest and parsley.
